overlays.title: Lantern Halls
overlays.adds: bigger glass lamps, a new bridge lamp
overlays.rewardMessage: You brought light home! The town lamps are glowing.

overlays.title: Sunrise Garden
overlays.adds: flower beds, lawn tufts, a flowering vine
overlays.rewardMessage: The garden woke up! Flowers are blooming everywhere.

overlays.title: Ember Kitchens
overlays.adds: shop chimney, bread, brick oven, long table
overlays.rewardMessage: Supper smells so good! The town has a table for everyone.

overlays.title: Giant's Steps
overlays.rewardMessage: Step by step! A new path is ready to explore.

overlays.title: Quiet River
overlays.adds: clear water, koi, lilies, sitting dock
overlays.rewardMessage: The river is calm and clear. Come sit a while!

overlays.title: Forge of Courage
overlays.rewardMessage: Be brave! The practice yard is ready for you.

overlays.title: Hall of Echoes
overlays.rewardMessage: Listen! The town sings hello to you.

overlays.title: Root Library
overlays.adds: reading tree, root bench, book-swap box
overlays.rewardMessage: A reading tree grew! Its roots go deep, like yours.

overlays.title: Storm Stair
overlays.adds: Tower glow, rainbow, puddles, window lantern
overlays.rewardMessage: The storm is quiet. The Tower glows bright for you!
